definition: Elliptical or egg-shaped mass, may include 2-3 gentle undulations.
Spherical/circular mass whose anteroposterior and transverse diameters are about equal.
suspicious_direction: round -> intermediate; less common in both groups

definition: Oval contour with one or more indentations giving an undulating outline; reintroduced in v2025.
suspicious_direction: lobulated -> slightly more suspicious than oval

definition: Mass that is neither round nor oval (nor lobulated).
suspicious_direction: irregular -> more suspicious; benign mimics exist (fat necrosis, mastitis, scar, sclerosing adenosis)
reported_ppv_or_effect: PPV 68.6% (24/35) [lex_yoon2016_pmc5040135, Yoon 2016 5th ed., n=80]; PPV 73.8% [lex_badupeprah2024_pmc11070917, Badu-Peprah 2024, n=60]

definition: Long axis of the mass parallel to the skin line ('wider than tall').
Long axis not parallel to the skin; anteroposterior dimension exceeds horizontal ('taller than wide').
reported_ppv_or_effect: PPV 52.9% (18/34) [lex_yoon2016_pmc5040135, Yoon 2016 5th ed., n=80]; PPV 85.7% [lex_badupeprah2024_pmc11070917, Badu-Peprah 2024, n=60]

definition: Well-defined, sharp margin with an abrupt transition between lesion and surrounding tissue over the whole contour.
suspicious_direction: circumscribed -> less suspicious; any non-circumscribed segment upgrades the margin

definition: No clear demarcation between all or part of the margin and surrounding tissue.
reported_ppv_or_effect: PPV 46.2% (6/13) [lex_yoon2016_pmc5040135, Yoon 2016 5th ed., n=80]; PPV 28.6% [lex_badupeprah2024_pmc11070917, Badu-Peprah 2024, n=60]

definition: Part or all of the margin forms sharp corners, often acute angles.
reported_ppv_or_effect: PPV 46.7% (7/15) [lex_yoon2016_pmc5040135, Yoon 2016 5th ed., n=80]; PPV 70.0% [lex_badupeprah2024_pmc11070917, Badu-Peprah 2024, n=60]

definition: Margin with many short-cycle small undulations (scalloped).
reported_ppv_or_effect: PPV 33.3% (4/12) [lex_yoon2016_pmc5040135, Yoon 2016 5th ed., n=80]; PPV 50.0% [lex_badupeprah2024_pmc11070917, Badu-Peprah 2024, n=60]

definition: Margin with sharp lines radiating from the mass.
reported_ppv_or_effect: PPV 70.6% (12/17) [lex_yoon2016_pmc5040135, Yoon 2016 5th ed., n=80]; PPV 100% [lex_badupeprah2024_pmc11070917, Badu-Peprah 2024, n=60]

feature: lesion boundary: abrupt interface (4th ed., removed in 5th)
definition: Sharp demarcation between lesion and surrounding tissue without a transition zone.
suspicious_direction: abrupt -> less suspicious; descriptor dropped in 5th edition

feature: lesion boundary: echogenic halo (4th ed., removed in 5th)
definition: Echogenic transition zone bridging the lesion and surrounding tissue; absence has no diagnostic meaning.
suspicious_direction: echogenic halo -> more suspicious (also in abscess)

definition: No internal echoes (fluid, as in a simple cyst).
Echogenicity greater than subcutaneous fat, equal to fibroglandular tissue.
suspicious_direction: hyperechoic -> usually benign (e.g. lipoma, fat necrosis)

feature: echo pattern: complex cystic and solid
definition: Mass with both anechoic (cystic) and echogenic (solid) components; v2025 keeps it for thick-walled/septated cysts or cysts with solid nodules.
suspicious_direction: solid component -> more suspicious than pure cyst

feature: echo pattern: mixed solid and cystic (BI-RADS v2025)
definition: Mass clearly containing both solid and cystic components; emphasises the solid part.
Echogenicity lower than subcutaneous fat.
suspicious_direction: hypoechoic -> common in both benign and malignant; weak discriminator alone
reported_ppv_or_effect: PPV 42.5% (17/40) [lex_yoon2016_pmc5040135, Yoon 2016 5th ed., n=80]; PPV 57.8% [lex_badupeprah2024_pmc11070917, Badu-Peprah 2024, n=60]

definition: Very low echogenicity, darker than typical hypoechoic solid tissue.
Echogenicity equal to subcutaneous fat.
Mixture of echogenic patterns within a solid mass.
suspicious_direction: heterogeneous -> raises suspicion mainly with irregular shape / non-circumscribed margin

definition: No shadowing or enhancement deep to the mass.
Increased echoes deep to the mass (good sound transmission, e.g. cysts, many fibroadenomas, some high-grade cancers).
suspicious_direction: enhancement -> benign-leaning but seen in high-grade tumours

definition: Decreased echoes deep to the mass (attenuation), excluding edge refraction shadows.
suspicious_direction: shadowing -> more suspicious (also scars, macrocalcification); v2025: any shadowing is significant
reported_ppv_or_effect: PPV 26.7% (4/15) [lex_yoon2016_pmc5040135, Yoon 2016 5th ed., n=80]; PPV 50.0% [lex_badupeprah2024_pmc11070917, Badu-Peprah 2024, n=60]

definition: Both shadowing and enhancement deep to the mass; Chang 2026 reports it removed in v2025, Kaplan 2026 table lists it preserved.
Echogenic foci inside a mass (microcalcifications most visible inside hypoechoic masses).
reported_ppv_or_effect: PPV 81.3% (13/16) [lex_yoon2016_pmc5040135, Yoon 2016 5th ed., n=80]; PPV 66.7% [lex_badupeprah2024_pmc11070917, Badu-Peprah 2024, n=60]

definition: Echogenic foci in fat or fibroglandular tissue outside a mass (may lie in a non-mass lesion).
suspicious_direction: present -> moderately suspicious; less conspicuous than on mammography

definition: Echogenic foci located within a duct (added in 5th edition).
Macro: large enough to attenuate the beam, usually shadowing (degenerating fibroadenoma, oil cyst); micro: tiny echogenic foci without shadow.
suspicious_direction: microcalcification in hypoechoic mass -> suspicious; isolated macrocalcification -> usually benign

definition: Disruption of surrounding tissue planes by the lesion (compression, obliteration of planes, thickened/straightened Cooper ligaments).
reported_ppv_or_effect: PPV 68.8% (11/16) [lex_yoon2016_pmc5040135, Yoon 2016 5th ed., n=80]; PPV 71.4% [lex_badupeprah2024_pmc11070917, Badu-Peprah 2024, n=60]

definition: Abnormal calibre and/or arborisation of a duct, extending to or from the mass, or intraductal mass/thrombus.
suspicious_direction: abnormal duct change -> more suspicious; solitary dilated duct malignancy up to 9.5%
reported_ppv_or_effect: PPV 54.5% (6/11) [lex_yoon2016_pmc5040135, Yoon 2016 5th ed., n=80]; solitary dilated duct malignancy rate 9.5% [lex_kaplan2026_pmc13361901]

definition: Focal or diffuse skin thickening >2 mm (except periareolar/inframammary).
suspicious_direction: present -> more suspicious (inflammatory carcinoma, but also mastitis, post-radiation)
in_our_data: yes (only if skin is in the image)

definition: Skin surface concave or ill-defined and pulled in.
reported_ppv_or_effect: Adjacent tissue retraction PPV 50.0% [lex_badupeprah2024_pmc11070917]; nipple retraction OR 7.5 for malignant US call [lex_alshoabi2023_pmc10191155]
in_our_data: yes (only if skin is in the image)

definition: Increased echogenicity of surrounding tissue with reticular network of hypoechoic lines (lymphatics/fluid).
reported_ppv_or_effect: PPV 40.0% (2/5) [lex_yoon2016_pmc5040135, Yoon 2016 5th ed., n=80]; skin edema PPV 76.5% [lex_badupeprah2024_pmc11070917]

definition: Lesion tissue extending into surrounding fat or parenchyma (study-specific term).
Thick, non-uniform echogenic band surrounding a lesion of any shape (peritumoral tissue reaction).
suspicious_direction: present -> more suspicious, more specific than sensitive; also fat necrosis
reported_ppv_or_effect: hyperechoic zone sens 87%, spec 81% (137 lesions, cited in [lex_chang2026_pmc13266155])

definition: Thin, uniform echogenic line surrounding (usually oval) mass.
suspicious_direction: present around oval/lobulated mass without other suspicious features -> likely benign

definition: Colour/power Doppler flow pattern; v2025 renames 'vessels in rim' to 'peripheral hypervascularity'.
suspicious_direction: internal or peripheral hypervascularity -> more suspicious; absent -> not reassuring by itself
reported_ppv_or_effect: vascularity PPV 67.7% [lex_badupeprah2024_pmc11070917, Badu-Peprah 2024, n=60]; NML hypervascularity PPV 17.0-81.7% [lex_kim2025_pmc12683742]

definition: Tissue stiffness from strain or shear-wave elastography.
suspicious_direction: hard -> more suspicious; must not overrule grayscale features
reported_ppv_or_effect: strain elastography + B-mode sens 99.0%, spec 91.5%; SWE AUC 0.928 vs 0.851 B-mode alone [lex_kaplan2026_pmc13361901]

definition: Focal area distinguishable from surrounding tissue that does not meet mass criteria (not seen as a 3D space-occupying lesion in two planes); shape/margin do not apply.
suspicious_direction: NML with linear/segmental distribution, duct change, calcification or shadowing -> suspicious
reported_ppv_or_effect: malignancy 10.4% screening, 43.4% diagnostic, 40.1% current cancer [lex_song2026_pmc13554624]; 2.2-8.0% screening vs 16.1-53.8% diagnostic [lex_kim2025_pmc12683742]

feature: NML distribution: focal / linear / segmental / regional / diffuse
definition: Spatial extent of a non-mass lesion; linear = along a duct, segmental = triangular towards nipple (one duct system).

feature: NML echo pattern: anechoic / hypoechoic / heterogeneous (mixed) / hyperechoic
definition: Internal echogenicity of a non-mass lesion.
suspicious_direction: mixed/heterogeneous -> somewhat more suspicious (inconsistent across studies)

definition: Echogenic foci within a non-mass lesion.
Shadowing deep to a non-mass area.
Non-mass area with multiple small cysts and no suspicious features (fibrocystic change).
suspicious_direction: small cysts without other features -> benign-leaning

definition: Distortion of fibroglandular tissue by a non-mass lesion.
Circumscribed, anechoic, oval/round mass with posterior enhancement and thin wall.

feature: special case: clustered microcysts / complicated cyst
definition: Cluster of tiny anechoic foci with thin septa / cyst with homogeneous low-level internal echoes.

feature: special case: mass in or on skin; foreign body incl. implants; post-surgical fluid collection; fat necrosis
definition: Lexicon special cases with characteristic appearance (sebaceous cyst, implant, seroma, fat necrosis).
suspicious_direction: usually benign but need clinical history

feature: special case: post-traumatic changes and abscess (v2025)
definition: New v2025 special cases; abscess shows thick echogenic rim, internal debris and clinical signs of infection.
suspicious_direction: benign but irregular and can mimic cancer; needs clinical context

definition: Node size, shape, cortical thickness, margin, fatty hilum, echogenic foci, symmetry, interval change (v2025 lymph-node category).
suspicious_direction: cortex >3 mm, eccentric cortical bulge, effaced/absent fatty hilum, round shape, non-circumscribed margin -> suspicious for metastasis
reported_ppv_or_effect: normal cortex <=3 mm [lex_chang2026_pmc13266155; lex_kaplan2026_pmc13361901]; node enlargement OR 5.7 for malignant US call [lex_alshoabi2023_pmc10191155]

feature: tissue composition: background echotexture / glandular tissue component (GTC, v2025)
definition: Whole-breast background (homogeneous fat, homogeneous fibroglandular, heterogeneous) and share of glandular tissue (minimal/mild/moderate/marked).
suspicious_direction: heterogeneous background lowers lesion conspicuity; high GTC -> higher cancer risk (risk factor, not lesion feature)
reported_ppv_or_effect: high vs low GTC HR 1.5 (95% CI 1.05-2.1) [lex_chang2026_pmc13266155]
in_our_data: partial (needs whole-breast view, not a lesion crop)

definition: Largest diameter of the lesion in mm.
suspicious_direction: larger -> more often malignant in some studies; mainly for staging and follow-up

feature: clinical context: patient age, symptoms/palpability, mammographic correlate, interval growth
definition: Non-image information radiologists use with the lexicon (screening vs diagnostic, prior exams).
suspicious_direction: older age, palpable/symptomatic, suspicious mammographic correlate, new or growing -> more suspicious
reported_ppv_or_effect: NML malignancy 2.8% with negative vs 28.8% with positive mammogram [lex_chang2026_pmc13266155]; screening 10.4% vs diagnostic 43.4% [lex_song2026_pmc13554624]

definition: 4*pi*Area/Perimeter^2; 1 for a perfect circle.
reported_ppv_or_effect: median benign 0.85 vs malignant 0.50 (BUS dataset) [quant_ye2026_pmc13002577]; half-contour TC AUC 0.78 in shadowed tumours [quant_zhou2015_pmc4414937]

definition: Area / convex hull area.
Convex hull perimeter / lesion perimeter.
suspicious_direction: lower -> more irregular margin -> more suspicious

definition: Area / bounding-box area.
Eccentricity of the ellipse with the same second moments (0 circle, ->1 elongated).
suspicious_direction: higher -> more suspicious in Ye 2026 (direction depends on orientation; benign fibroadenomas are also elongated but parallel)

definition: Max vertical extent / max horizontal extent of the lesion (image axes).
Major / minor axis of the equivalent ellipse.
suspicious_direction: higher -> more elongated; read together with orientation (parallel elongated masses are often fibroadenomas)

definition: Angle between the lesion's long axis and the skin line.
reported_ppv_or_effect: cut-off >22.3 deg: sens 84.9%, spec 82.8%; AUC 0.838 vs 0.651 visual [quant_chen2026_pmc13005611]

definition: Perimeter^2/Area-type measure of similarity to a circle (several definitions; inverse of circularity).
Lesion perimeter relative to the perimeter of its fitted (equivalent) ellipse.
suspicious_direction: perimeter much larger than ellipse perimeter -> lobulated/spiculated -> more suspicious

definition: Number of skeleton points of the lesion normalised by the perimeter of the equivalent ellipse.
suspicious_direction: more skeleton branches -> more irregular -> more suspicious

definition: (A_ellipse + A_tumour - A_intersection) / A_tumour.
suspicious_direction: higher -> shape deviates from ellipse -> more suspicious

definition: (A_convexhull - A_tumour) / A_tumour.

feature: number of contour peaks (NumPeaks) / lobulation count
definition: Local maxima of the distance between contour and convex hull (counts lobulations).
suspicious_direction: more peaks -> bumpier (microlobulated) margin -> more suspicious

definition: Mean distance between contour and convex hull.

feature: normalized radial length (NRL) mean / SD / entropy
definition: Distances from centroid to contour points normalised by the maximum; statistics describe boundary roughness.
suspicious_direction: higher SD/entropy -> irregular margin -> more suspicious

definition: Average variation between neighbouring normalized radial lengths, a measure of margin spiculation (Zhou 2015).

feature: standard deviation of degree (SDD) of contour
definition: Variability of local contour direction along the (half) contour.
suspicious_direction: higher -> irregular -> more suspicious; robust to posterior shadowing when computed on the upper half contour
reported_ppv_or_effect: half-contour SDD AUC 0.81 vs full-contour 0.61 in shadowed tumours [quant_zhou2015_pmc4414937]

definition: Percentage of tumour area lying outside the circle defined by the mean radial length (Zhou 2015).
Ratio of low- to high-frequency area of the contour (radial) signal spectrum.
suspicious_direction: Huang 2018: value reported as proportional to malignancy likelihood

definition: Number/size of contour undulations (classic CAD definition relative to the maximum inscribed circle; Daoud 2020 lists it without formula).
Divider/box-counting fractal dimension of the lesion boundary.
suspicious_direction: higher -> more complex margin -> more suspicious

definition: Form factor 4*pi*A/P^2; roundness 4*A/(pi*major_axis^2) (common CAD definitions; Daoud 2020 lists names only).

feature: ellipse-fit features (axis lengths, axis ratio, major-axis angle, ellipse-tumour overlap)
definition: Parameters of the best-fit ellipse and its agreement with the lesion.
suspicious_direction: low overlap, long axis non-parallel to skin -> more suspicious

feature: 2D shape set (PyRadiomics/IBSI): mesh area, perimeter, perimeter-to-surface ratio, sphericity, max 2D diameter, major/minor axis length, elongation
definition: Standardised 2D shape descriptors from the mask.
suspicious_direction: less round/compact -> more suspicious (no fixed thresholds)

feature: edge indistinctness / margin sharpness (gradient across boundary)
definition: Intensity gradient or contrast across the lesion boundary band.
suspicious_direction: blurred (low gradient) margin -> indistinct -> more suspicious

definition: Mean grey level inside the mask relative to surrounding tissue or fat.
suspicious_direction: darker than surrounding tissue (markedly hypoechoic) -> more suspicious

feature: posterior acoustic difference (Shadow = mean I_posterior - mean I_tumour)
definition: Mean intensity of a same-size region beneath the lesion minus mean lesion intensity; negative = shadow.

feature: posterior region statistics / Hu moments of posterior region
definition: Std, mean, or shape moments of the region behind the lesion.
Entropy of the distribution of intensity differences between adjacent pixels inside the lesion.
suspicious_direction: weak alone (RF AUC 0.481 [quant_fleury2019_pmc6682836]); higher -> more heterogeneous

feature: first-order intensity features (mean, variance, skewness, kurtosis, entropy, energy, percentiles)
definition: Statistics of the grey-level histogram inside the mask.

feature: GLCM features (contrast, correlation, energy, homogeneity, entropy, cluster shade/prominence, IMC1/2, IDN, IDMN)
definition: Second-order statistics of how often grey-level pairs co-occur at given offsets/angles.
suspicious_direction: study-specific; malignant lesions often more heterogeneous

definition: Higher-order texture: run lengths, zone sizes, dependence and neighbourhood tone differences of grey levels.
Histogram of binary codes comparing each pixel with its neighbours (micro-texture).
Histogram of local gradient directions in image cells (edge/structure layout).
First-order and texture features computed on wavelet or Laplacian-of-Gaussian filtered images.
Radiomic features from a ring (e.g. 3 mm) around the mask.
Parameters from raw RF data (spectral slope, intercept, Nakagami etc.).
Learned image representations, optionally combined with handcrafted features.
reported_ppv_or_effect: VGG19 conv features + morphology accuracy 96.1% vs 94.2% alone [quant_daoud2020_pmc7730057]
